allowance_audit.diagnosed_contract: Old q bounds distance to EVERY stress prediction. Its residual contains state sensitivity, then its outer interval retains the state extrema again; abs(q) also sends a negative residual into upper-side pessimism. Valid deliberate conservatism, not an arithmetic bug. Calibrating error outside the already-shared envelope is a different, explicit empirical target.
allowance_audit.not_double_added_to_safety: Position/yaw tube and mapping uncertainty enlarge physical support/margin vetoes, not the performance cost scalar. Common underlying errors can block both tests, but no q-to-trajectory numerical addition exists. Physical guards are kept unchanged because relative cost cancellation cannot certify clearance.

new_target.formula: For each shared reference r: L_r=min_sD_sr,U_r=max_sD_sr; fit q_lower=max_CAL,r(L_r-A_r)_+, q_upper=max_CAL,r(A_r-U_r)_+, then a NEW conservative .05 floor on each. Expand [min_r L_r-q_lower,max_r U_r+q_upper] once.
new_target.floor_provenance: NEW residual floor, not an original floor. Original material-order threshold remains .05. No weights, physics, safety, candidate directions/magnitudes, horizon, observer or pilot eligibility envelope changed.
